name: Exp_AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 custom indicator, which identifies trend direction changes. It opens buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position sizing based on a share of the deposit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标用于识别趋势方向变化。在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈以及基于存款比例的仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，产生买入信号；当指标缓冲区0（DnValue）出现有效值时，产生卖出信号。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号触发空头平仓，卖出信号触发多头平仓），二是通过固定的止损和止盈点数平仓。仓位管理采用基于存款比例的方法，通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用存款的比例，并支持LOT和MARGIN两种计算模式。资金管理方面，EA在历史K线中向前搜索最近的反向信号来判断是否需要平仓，确保在没有直接反向信号时也能根据历史趋势方向决定仓位。策略还包含新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线内重复交易，但缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 custom indicator. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, a buy signal is generated; when indicator buffer 0 (DnValue) shows a valid value, a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first, through reverse signal closing (a buy signal triggers short position closure, a sell signal triggers long position closure), and second, through fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing uses a deposit share-based method controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN calculation modes. For money management, the EA searches backward through historical bars for the most recent reverse signal to determine whether position closing is needed when no direct reverse signal exists on the current bar. The strategy includes a new bar detection mechanism via the CIsNewBar class to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, but lacks scaling in or scaling out logic for position management.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方法（固定手数或保证金模式）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lot or percentage)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于趋势跟踪信号进行交易，方向明确
支持灵活的仓位管理，可按存款比例动态调整手数
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立配置，交易控制粒度细致
具有新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
使用SignalBar参数可灵活选择信号确认的延迟程度
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on trend-following signals with well-defined direction
Flexible position sizing that dynamically adjusts lot size based on deposit share
Independent configuration of buy/sell open and close permissions for granular trade control
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated entries within the same bar
SignalBar parameter allows flexible selection of signal confirmation delay
cons: 依赖自定义指标AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2，缺少该指标时EA无法运行且不便于回测验证
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
历史K线遍历搜索反向信号可能效率低下，在长历史数据中存在性能问题
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对多数品种不合适
缺少多时间周期确认和额外的过滤条件，容易产生假信号
cons_en: Depends on the custom AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 indicator which must be available, making backtesting and deployment less portable
Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Backward bar traversal to search for reverse signals may be inefficient on long historical data
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and additional filtering conditions, making it prone to false signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤条件，减少不利成交和假信号
优化历史反向信号搜索逻辑，设置最大搜索K线数上限避免无限遍历
improvements_en: Add spread and volatility filters to reduce unfavorable fills and false signals
Optimize the historical reverse signal search logic by setting a maximum bar search limit to prevent infinite traversal

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差品种上可能导致滑点损失
默认止损止盈点数过大，可能导致单笔亏损过大
历史K线遍历无上限，极端情况下可能影响执行延迟
risk_points_en: No spread filter, which may cause slippage losses on high-spread instruments
Default stop loss and take profit point values are very large, potentially leading to excessive per-trade losses
Unbounded historical bar traversal may cause execution delays in extreme cases

It opens buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position sizing based on a share of the deposit.
